_comment: Wave-5.5 furniture ratchet baseline. Regenerated by scripts/ratchet/check.sh's own recompute logic — see that script for the exact find/rg commands. Do not hand-edit the counts without rerunning them; hand-edit only the metadata fields (computed_at_commit, computed_date, bump_reason) when intentionally moving the baseline.

giant_files.description: Non-test .rs files with >= 800 lines. Non-test = path has no 'tests/' directory component, filename is not 'tests.rs' and does not end '_tests.rs'. vendor/ and target/ excluded.

allow_attrs.description: Occurrences of '#[allow(' under crates/*/src, excluding test files (same non-test definition as giant_files).

_census_ratchet_txt_per_crate_src_column._note: census-ratchet.txt (recon artifact, same base commit) reports a coarser per-crate 'src' figure that sums to 92, not 88 here. Its exclusion only drops paths under a literal tests/ directory, not sibling test-named files (e.g. src/tests.rs, src/authority/tests.rs, src/hnsw/tests.rs) — those still counted as 'src' there. This baseline additionally excludes those sibling test files per the ratchet's own non-test definition above. Kept here for provenance, not as the enforced number.

print_macros.description: Combined occurrences of println!, eprintln!, and dbg! under crates/*/src, excluding test files (same non-test definition as giant_files). Counted with word-boundary-anchored patterns so 'eprintln!' lines are not double-counted by a bare 'println!' substring match.

_census_ratchet_txt_per_crate_src_column._note: Same test-file-exclusion gap as allow_attrs above (census-ratchet.txt's 'src' column includes sibling tests.rs/*_tests.rs files); its println+eprintln+dbg sum is 136, not 88 here. All 4 of oneiron's census-reported println!/eprintln! hits, for example, are in src/tests.rs and src/hnsw/tests.rs — test files excluded from this baseline.
